correctionAndAcceptanceGates.correction: Supply exact immutable producer path and complete output-to-input assertion lineage. Classify behavioral observations separately from product facts; prohibit household IDs, raw timestamps, fine location, stable contributor keys in public payload.
correctionAndAcceptanceGates.acceptance: Synthetic malicious payload containing a private trip field despite public assertion graph is withheld; changed producer epoch invalidates caches; no unknown/missing lineage promotes.

correctionAndAcceptanceGates.acceptance: Setting true or permissive provider licence alone cannot publish; unknown rights, personal data marker omission and missing purpose/decision all deny. No credentials or actual private records in tests.

correctionAndAcceptanceGates.correction: Define allowlisted measures, population/unit (distinct contributors or households), contribution clipping, approved bucket widths, risk-derived suppression plus complementary suppression, restricted dimension/intersection catalogue.

correctionAndAcceptanceGates.owner: 02 release caller with 30 accounting owner for separate privacy ledger
correctionAndAcceptanceGates.correction: Bound query composition across accounts, windows, audiences and releases; prohibit arbitrary adaptive queries. If a DP mechanism is selected, independently specify adjacency, clipping, epsilon/delta, composition, correlated caching and fail-closed exhaustion.
correctionAndAcceptanceGates.acceptance: A3/A6/A10 remain protected under distributed retries/cache hits/account rotation, window rollover and concurrent queries; provider budget does not reset disclosure cost; no invented DP guarantee.

correctionAndAcceptanceGates.correction: Include contribution choice/purpose/entitlement epoch in authoritative graph; recheck at job start, commit and serve. Inventory derivative cache/search/export/embedding stores, pending jobs and backup restore replay; distinguish retention expiry from freshness.
correctionAndAcceptanceGates.acceptance: Rights narrowing or withdrawal during fetch/reserve/write/serve returns no new output; revoked dependency cannot survive warm cache or restore; independent public evidence must have separate valid lineage. Recomputed release must pass A8 differencing review.

correctionAndAcceptanceGates.correction: Keep contributor linkage in restricted purpose-bound ledger with specified retention; apply authorization and purpose limits to query logs, metrics, cache keys, fingerprints and quota readbacks. No public stable contributor identifier.
correctionAndAcceptanceGates.acceptance: A7 demonstrates link risk; account B and household role never grant private health or provider account access. Query errors, timing/hit state and logs are checked for membership inference before widening.
